snippet.title: Defiance - Arkhunters, unite! [In-game Trailer]
snippet.description:
Arkhunters, answer the call; April 18, 2025, at 10:00 UTC.

In silence, we wait...
The Arkfalls fade...
The earth is broken,
But we stand tall!

Defiance, we rise!
Arkhunters, unite!
The Arkfalls we ignite!

Arkhunters answer the call...
The world is waiting...

Defiance, we rise!

---
❤️ fawkes.games
